notes.title: Meet The Artist - Neo Art Space
notes.notes:
Philip Noyed, known for his public art installations, is set to debut his first-ever VR experience, Neo Art Space. Coming in February of 2022, this giant, hand-painted virtual reality art adventure will allow multiple players to experience the space simultaneously from anywhere in the world. Neo Art Space is unique from any other VR art experience in that it is cutting edge contemporary light art that is vast in scale, with interactive elements and dynamic sound design.

Chat with Philip, learn about his process, and hear about his path to VR creation!
